It slices through armor like a hot knife through butter!|Allies|AoC}} Guardian Swords++ go unnamed in {{MK8D}}. ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Weapon |strength = 40 |durability = 32 |flammable = No |magnetic = No |buoyant = Yes |conductive = No |guardian = Yes |throw = Yes |throw effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Guardian Sword++}} Guardian Swords++ are the final class of [[Guardian Sword]]s, surpassing [[Guardian Sword+|Guardian Swords+]] in both strength and durability. They are larger than both previous iterations and are said to easily slice through [[Armor]]. [[Guardian Scout IV|Guardian Scouts IV]] use them in "A Major Test of Strength" [[Ancient Shrine]]s, and they can be obtained after their defeat. They also appear in [[Treasure Chest]]s that spawn after scanning the {{BotW}} Series [[Guardian]] [[amiibo]] with the [[Amiibo (Ability)|amiibo]] [[Rune]]. Since they are made from [[Ancient Technology]], Guardian Swords++ will deal additional damage if they are used to attack Guardians. They will not burn if they are exposed to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]], they do not conduct [[Electricity]] or attract [[Lightning]] during [[Thunderstorm]]s, and they will float if they are dropped in the [[Water (Terrain)|Water]]. Finally, they can not be picked up with the [[Magnesis]] Rune. Guardian Swords++ belong to the [[Guardian Gear]] equipment archetype, which includes all [[Weapon]]s used by [[Guardian Scout]]s.{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC |publisher= |page= 175}} {{BotW Weapon Parameters |ActorName = "Weapon_Sword_015" |Life = 32 |Power = 40 |SpHitActor = Actors with tags "TeamGuardian", "IsEffectiveAncientWeapon"; "Enemy_Ganon", "Enemy_SiteBoss_", "Enemy_Guardian_Mini_" {{List Note|All Guardians and Guardian Scouts, Calamity Ganon and Dark Beast Ganon, All Ganon Blights, Guardian legs/propellers}} |SpHitRatio = 1.3 |IsHammer = false |IsWeakBreaker = false |IsBoomerang = false |IsLuckyWeapon = false |IsPikohan = false |IsThrowingWeapon = true |IsThrowingBreakWeapon = true |ThrowRange = 5.0 |ChemicalEnergyMax = 0 |ChemicalEnergyAmountUsed = 0 |ChemicalEnergyRecoverRate = 0.0 |ChemicalEnergyRecoverInterval = 60 |ShootBeam = "" |SharpWeaponAddAtkMin = 5 |SharpWeaponAddAtkMax = 10 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMin = 4 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMax = 7 |SharpWeaponAddCrit = true |PoweredSharpAddAtkMin = 11 |PoweredSharpAddAtkMax = 20 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMin = 8 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMax = 16 |PoweredSharpAddThrowMin = 1.5 |PoweredSharpAddThrowMax = 2.0 |ThrowSpeed = 1.0 |ThrowRotSpeed = 50.0 |SellingPrice = 45 |BuyingPrice = 114 }} ==Other Appearances== ==={{MK8D|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} A Guardian Sword++ was introduced in the version 1.6.0 update of {{MK8D}}.
